rankings.title: Descriptive rankings
rankings.subtitle: Numerical order of published values for one indicator, year, period and scope. No qualitative judgement.
rankings.method_note: Rank = position of the value in the chosen order. Equal values share a rank (1, 1, 3). One authoritative value per institution; rejected, divergent or under-review values are excluded; no currency conversion.
rankings.blocked_needs_review: Ranking cannot be computed: needs review
rankings.empty: No institution has an admissible value for this selection.
rankings.unavailable_hint: These institutions have no admissible value: they receive no rank.
rankings.history_empty: No fiscal year available for this indicator.

ranking_reasons.heterogeneous_currency: Incompatible currencies: no conversion is performed
ranking_reasons.no_period: No fiscal year holds data for this selection

ranking_reasons.aggregate_not_supported: Not available for this indicator: ratios and annual changes are not aggregated.
ranking_reasons.not_in_sector_total: Value not included in the sector total
ranking_reasons.no_data: No financial data stored for this institution
ranking_reasons.no_data_for_selection: No data for this scope and period type
ranking_reasons.no_computable_value: No value can be computed from the available components

comparisons.title: Factual comparisons
comparisons.subtitle: Values of 2 to 5 institutions on the same indicator, fiscal year, period and scope, then institution ↔ sector and country ↔ UMOA.
comparisons.method_note: Differences are numerical differences with the first institution. No currency conversion; a non-homogeneous comparison is not computed.
comparisons.select_hint: Choose 2 to 5 institutions to display their values.
comparisons.sector_note: Individual annual accounts, as for sector aggregates.

data_explorer.title: UMOA financial data
data_explorer.subtitle: Every stored financial observation, filterable, with its source.
data_explorer.note_rows: Each row is an observation as stored: no currency conversion, no total, no average. Rejected observations are not listed as valid data.
data_explorer.note_value_sort: Sorted by value: rows are grouped by currency; values in different currencies are not compared.
